title: Stage-Specific Regulation of Ubiquitination Modifications and Prospects for Targeted Therapy in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
authors: Wang, Yongpan; Huang, Weiqiang; Lin, Qizhuan; Cai, Helei; Dai, Fengjin; Gu, Haiqing; Yu, Shunyan; Jin, Libo; Peng, Renyi
one_liner_zh: 综述泛素化修饰在三阴性乳腺癌分期调控及靶向治疗中的作用，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与课题无关。
abstract: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is an aggressive subtype of breast cancer characterized by poor clinical outcomes. Owing to the absence of estrogen receptors, progesterone receptors, and Human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor 2 (HER2) expression, TNBC shows limited responsiveness to conventional endocrine and targeted therapies. This subtype exhibits strong heterogeneity, a high propensity for metastasis, and a tendency to develop acquired drug resistance. Its survival and progression largely rely on non-classical signaling pathways, including Epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR), Phosphoinositide 3-kinase/Protein Kinase B (PI3K/AKT), and Notch, which collectively impose substantial challenges to clinical management. In recent years, protein post-translational modifications-particularly ubiquitination and ubiquitin-like modifications-have emerged as key mechanisms governing TNBC malignant progression. This review systematically summarizes the stage-specific regulatory roles of ubiquitination during TNBC initiation, progression, and therapeutic resistance. These mechanisms include modulation of tumor stemness, epithelial-mesenchymal transition, DNA damage repair, ferroptosis, and immune evasion through the regulation of critical proteins such as Toll-like receptor 4/Nuclear factor kappa-B (TLR4/NF-kappaB), Twist family bHLH transcription factor 1 (TWIST1), Poly (ADP-Ribose) Polymerase 1 (PARP1), Programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1), and Glutathione Peroxidase 4 (GPX4). In addition, ubiquitin-like modifications (including small ubiquitin-like modifier (SUMOylation), Neural precursor cell expressed developmentally downregulated protein 8 (NEDDylation), and Interferon-stimulated gene (ISGylation)) function synergistically in maintaining genome stability, transcriptional regulation, and immunological processes. Furthermore, this review highlights the translational potential of targeting ubiquitination pathways in TNBC, covering the applications, advantages, and limitations of immune checkpoint inhibitors, Poly ADP-ribose polymerase (PARP) inhibitors, antibody-drug conjugates, and combination treatment strategies. Finally, it outlines future research directions, such as developing a TNBC-specific ubiquitinome landscape, creating highly selective E3 ligase or deubiquitinase inhibitors, and integrating multi-omics with artificial intelligence technologies. These advances are expected to provide a theoretical foundation and translational insights for precision interventions targeting protein homeostasis in TNBC.
abstract_zh: 三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）是乳腺癌的一种侵袭性亚型，以临床预后不良为特征。由于缺乏雌激素受体、孕激素受体和人表皮生长因子受体2（HER2）的表达，TNBC对传统内分泌治疗和靶向治疗的响应有限。该亚型表现出强烈的异质性、高转移倾向以及获得性耐药的发展趋势。其生存和进展主要依赖于非经典信号通路，包括表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）、磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶/蛋白激酶B（PI3K/AKT）和Notch，这些共同对临床管理构成重大挑战。近年来，蛋白质翻译后修饰——特别是泛素化和泛素样修饰——已成为调控TNBC恶性进展的关键机制。本综述系统总结了泛素化在TNBC起始、进展和治疗耐药中的阶段特异性调控作用。这些机制包括通过调控Toll样受体4/核因子kappa-B（TLR4/NF-kappaB）、Twist家族bHLH转录因子1（TWIST1）、聚ADP核糖聚合酶1（PARP1）、程序性死亡配体1（PD-L1）和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4）等关键蛋白，调节肿瘤干性、上皮-间质转化、DNA损伤修复、铁死亡和免疫逃逸。此外，泛素样修饰（包括小泛素样修饰物（SUMO化）、神经前体细胞表达发育下调蛋白8（NEDD化）和干扰素刺激基因（ISG化））在维持基因组稳定性、转录调控和免疫过程中发挥协同作用。进一步地，本综述强调了靶向泛素化通路在TNBC中的转化潜力，涵盖免疫检查点抑制剂、聚ADP核糖聚合酶（PARP）抑制剂、抗体-药物偶联物及联合治疗策略的应用、优势和局限性。最后，它概述了未来研究方向，如构建TNBC特异性泛素化组图谱、开发高选择性E3连接酶或去泛素化酶抑制剂，以及将多组学与人工智能技术整合。这些进展有望为TNBC中靶向蛋白质稳态的精准干预提供理论基础和转化见解。
